title: Pivot BotSpy from Python to Rust
description: Single Rust library crate (no binary/CLI/server/FFI); Python package, behave, pytest, ruff, python-semantic-release removed; cucumber-rs runs the specs; release-plz replaces python-semantic-release. Done when: cargo test/clippy/fmt are green and CI passes on all targets.
right_now_summary: The project is moving from Python to a single Rust library crate.
